(function(){
 // Adapt parse_catalog's catalog-box anchor traversal to the observed PC/mobile DOM.
 var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result||''),baseUrl);
 var box=doc.select('#dir').first()||doc.select('.dir_box').first();
 if(!box){
  if(/Just a moment|Cloudflare|challenge-platform|cf-browser-verification|security check/i.test(String(result||'')))throw Error('九九藏书网触发 Cloudflare 验证，请在书源登录中完成验证后重试。');
  throw Error('九九藏书网目录容器缺失，请在调试中检查目录响应。');
 }
 var bookId=/\/book\/(\d+)/.exec(String(baseUrl));
 var anchors=box.select('a[href]'),list=[],seen={};
 for(var i=0;i<anchors.size();i++){
  var a=anchors.get(i),url=String(a.attr('abs:href'));
  var match=/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.|m\.|read\.)?99csw\.com\/book\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html?(?:[?#].*)?$/.exec(url);
  if(!match||(bookId&&match[1]!==bookId[1]))continue;
  // Mobile catalogs repeat the last group; use canonical PC chapter URLs once.
  url='https://www.99csw.com/book/'+match[1]+'/'+match[2]+'.htm';
  if(seen[url])continue;
  seen[url]=true;
  list.push({name:String(a.text()).trim(),url:url});
 }
 return list;
})()
</js>
